question: Is there a verified incentive program that makes BTC15m -- or any accessible PMUS/Kalshi market -- net profitable at our capital?

labels.CONFIRMED_PAID: the venue credited this account and we hold the record
labels.MEASURED_PROGRAM: fetched live from the venue's own program API today; a published program, NOT money received
labels.ESTIMATED: arithmetic on measured program parameters at our size; never counted as realized
labels.UNVERIFIED: a unit or formula we have not confirmed against a credited payout

pmus_maker_rebate.source: pmus_incentive_audit single run, 2026-10-07T03:07:47Z, recovered from Railway deploy logs
pmus_maker_rebate.mechanism: per-fill NEGATIVE commission, not a program. credit = round_half_even(0.0125 * qty * p * (1-p), $0.01)
pmus_maker_rebate.rate_basis: the separate 25-row credit set: $0.4200 over 119.4900 contracts. Believed a SUBSET of the 825 credited fills; never summed with them.
pmus_maker_rebate.program_attribution: NONE -- this is an exchange-wide fee rebate, attributable to no programId

pmus_liquidity_program_payouts.why: 0 published programs have ever covered a market we traded

kalshi.why: no incentivised Kalshi market has ever been traded by this account

gemini.why: AdminCredit export unreachable; venue illustration is not our executions

maker_rebate_on_the_4_nov2_fills.why_unconfirmed: all four fees_actual rows carry rebate_usd: None. The executor reads commissionNotionalTotalCollected on /v1/order/{id}; the credit is posted as commissionNotionalCollected on /v1/portfolio/activities -- a different field on a different object.

btc15m_direct_check.verdict: NOT ELIGIBLE -- the market object carries no rewards/incentive block of any kind

kalshi.period_reward_unit: UNVERIFIED -- centi-cents assumed (10,000 = $1), which fits Kalshi's advertised $1-$1,000 per market per day
kalshi.measured_books_on_the_largest_pools: EMPTY on both sides (yes and no) for all six sampled

fifteen_minute_series_active_programs.KXBTC15M: absent from the program list entirely

kalshi.verdict: every 15-minute series has ZERO active programs. The August 2026 KXCRYPTOLEAD15M opportunity has expired.

pmus_fee_schedule_confirmed.our_tier: base rate; orders of magnitude below the first tier
pmus_fee_schedule_confirmed.note: the deployed executor uses taker theta 0.0695; the documented exchange-wide figure is 0.06. The maker rebate 0.0125 agrees in both and is the only term that matters here.

estimated_achievable_share.basis: our capital converted to contracts at p=0.50, against the program's own targetSize. ESTIMATED, never realized.

kalshi_best_active.caveat: assumes scoring against targetSize with no competing qualifier. The sampled books are EMPTY, which is both the upside and the warning: no price discovery, maximum adverse selection, and settlement in 2027-2030.

target_arithmetic.verdict: the confirmed maker-rebate rate cannot reach $480/day at any size this account can fund.

integrated_ledger_no_double_count.rule: realized net = matched-pair P&L + residual P&L + CONFIRMED credited incentives - fees. Published programs and formula estimates are excluded.
double_count_guards: the $10.51 earnings endpoint and the $10.36 per-fill total are two measures of one quantity -- never summed
the $0.42 / 25-row set is believed a subset of the 825 credited fills -- never summed with them
the $7.50 net account incentive spans markets far beyond BTC15m and is NOT attributable to the BTC15m ledger
L5's international MAKER_REBATE/REWARD/TAKER_REBATE streams are another venue and another era -- never cross-attributed

ranking.opportunity: PMUS maker rebate on existing BTC15m flow
ranking.verdict: the only incentive that has ever paid this account, and far too small to offset a -$2.96 campaign.

ranking.opportunity: Kalshi liquidity programs on active long-dated markets
ranking.expected_net: $1-$7/day gross at our capital, before adverse selection
ranking.capital: targetSize 1000 contracts is ~$500/market, 25x our cash and above the $20 exposure cap
ranking.ops_cost: a Kalshi executor does not exist -- new venue integration, which is out of scope
ranking.adverse_selection: unquantifiable: the sampled books are empty, settlement is 2027-2030, capital locks for years

ranking.ops_cost: needs a politics model we do not have
ranking.adverse_selection: 6c max spread forces tight two-sided quoting in markets we cannot price
ranking.verdict: capturing 100% of PMUS's entire reward spend would still not reach $480/day.

recommendation: NO-GO on incentives as a path to profitability at current capital. BTC15m is confirmed ineligible for every PMUS program; every 15-minute series on both venues has zero active programs; and the one incentive that has ever paid this account -- the exchange-wide maker rebate at $0.00351/contract -- is 475x short of the $480/day target at our clip.
next_executable_action: Re-run pmus_incentive_audit where the credentials live (the Railway service), to (a) close the $0.15 earnings-vs-per-fill gap, (b) recover the per-fill credit detail lost with the removed deployment, and (c) confirm or refute the $0.03 expected rebate on the four Nov-2 BTC15m fills. Read-only, no orders, no new service. Until that runs, no incentive-inclusive realized figure can be claimed for BTC15m at all.
also_worth_fixing: the executor reads commissionNotionalTotalCollected on /v1/order/{id} while the credit is posted as commissionNotionalCollected on /v1/portfolio/activities. Until that is reconciled, maker rebates on live fills will keep recording as UNKNOWN.
